arguments.content:
# LAMMPS input script for Mg melting simulation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Mg.data
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# Set timestep
timestep 0.001

# NVT equilibration at 300K
velocity all create 300.0 12345
fix 1 all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1
thermo 100
run 10000
unfix 1

# NPT relaxation at 300K
fix 2 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 10000
unfix 2

# NPT heating from 300K to 2000K
fix 3 all npt temp 300.0 2000.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Output commands
variable density equal density
fix density_output all print 100 "${density}" file density.txt

run 20000

# Print final density
print "Final density = ${density}"

arguments.content:
# Aluminum melting simulation

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read initial structure
read_data Al.data

# Create replicated system (5x5x5)
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Define compute for density
compute density all property/atom mass
compute sum_mass all reduce sum c_density
variable volume equal vol
variable density equal c_sum_mass/(v_volume*6.022e23)*1.0e24

# Initialize velocities
velocity all create 300.0 12345

# NVT equilibration
fix 1 all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1
timestep 0.001
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density v_density
run 10000
unfix 1

# NPT relaxation
fix 2 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 10000
unfix 2

# NPT heating
fix 3 all npt temp 300.0 2000.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 20000

# Print final density
print "Final_density: ${density}"
